Mesh optimization: measured cost and next candidate

M08 has 254,989 cells. Remote water below z = −3 m and air above z = 3.2 m contain 62,073 cells (24.3%). Moderate coarsening there is the first candidate. The physical domain, foil, prisms, near-foil box, wake and free-surface band remain protected.

Left: actual M08 projected cell extent. Right: accepted M07 velocity disturbance relative to U = 18 m/s, averaged in 0.5 m bins. Dashed lines bound the proposed protected middle region. Small disturbance suggests where to test coarsening; it is not an accuracy guarantee.
Conditional M09 design

Use this design if settled M08 is consistent with the denser M07. Otherwise resolve the remaining refinement discrepancy first. M09 is prepared as a design and has not been built or admitted to flow.

PARAMETER	M08	CANDIDATE M09
OUTER BASE SIZE	142.9 mm	250 mm
MIDDLE BAND, Z = −3…3.2 M	Existing controls	142.9 mm protection + existing finer controls
FOIL TARGET / MINIMUM	2.857 / 0.286 mm	Unchanged
FIRST LAYER / LAYERS / TOTAL	1.531 μm / 48 / 15.46 mm	Unchanged
NEAR-FOIL / SURFACE-BAND TARGETS	8.929 / 28.571 mm	Unchanged
DOMAIN AND SOURCE FOIL	Current verified geometry	Unchanged
Estimated savings — not a measured new-mesh result
OUTER TARGET	IDEAL CELL ESTIMATE	CELL REDUCTION	INDICATIVE STEP-TIME REDUCTION
200 mm	224,586	11.9%	5.8%
250 mm	213,185	16.4%	8.0%
300 mm	206,992	18.8%	9.2%

Cell estimates use two-dimensional area scaling only in the remote zones; mesh transitions may reduce savings. Time estimates use a descriptive fit to three measured cases (M04/M06/M07), with shared-machine load and different cell shapes. Confirm actual cells, quality, runtime and both mean coefficients before acceptance.

Free-surface mesh for waves

The current M08 surface band contains 50,452 cells; median projected dimensions are 31.0 × 31.4 mm. The requested wave starting resolution is about 200 × 25 mm: 100/150 cells per 20/30 m wavelength and 20 per 0.5 m wave height. This requires directional refinement, not simply increasing the existing isotropic size to 200 mm. It needs a compatible mesh construction and a propagation/CFL check.

Keep prism height and layer count fixed during the outer-region test because the M06/M07 difference is mainly in viscous drag. Test 10 versus 20 inner iterations separately; reducing cells alone is unlikely to halve runtime.

Basis: actual CGNS cell polygons, accepted M06/M07 velocity exports and measured timing. General guidance: CFD Direct: external-flow refinement; Siemens: anisotropic meshing capabilities. The Siemens page does not establish a drop-in anisotropic option for our current directed polygon source mesher.
